updates.checksum.help: The download is checked against the release's SHA-256 checksums, which are signed with the Glowfly project's key, so it is the file the project released. The builds themselves aren't code-signed yet.
updates.chip_tip.install_restart: Install the update and restart Glowfly
updates.chip_tip.open_quit: Open the installer and quit Glowfly
updates.details.tip: Show the update's status in Preferences
updates.flatpak.available: Glowfly {version} is available. Update it with Flatpak or your software centre.
updates.flatpak.how: This copy was installed with Flatpak, so Flatpak updates it: run flatpak update or use your software centre, then start Glowfly again. A copy installed from a downloaded .flatpak file updates by installing the new release's .flatpak file the same way.
updates.last_install.busy: Glowfly {version} wasn't installed because another installation was running. Try the update again later.
updates.last_install.cancelled: The installer for Glowfly {version} was cancelled, so Glowfly wasn't updated.
updates.last_install.failed: The installer for Glowfly {version} failed, so Glowfly wasn't updated.
updates.last_install.failed_code: The installer for Glowfly {version} failed (error {code}), so Glowfly wasn't updated.
updates.last_install.not_run: The installer for Glowfly {version} couldn't start: {error}
updates.restart_busy: Wait for the running operation to finish, then install the update.
updates.restart_confirm.title: Restart to update?
updates.saved.changed: The downloaded file {path} no longer matches its checksum.
updates.saved.missing: The downloaded file {path} is no longer there.
updates.whats_new.tip: Show the release notes for this version
